verified_sources: Honda TechInfo, DriveAccord, PRL Motorsports, Honda owner's manual, AccordXClub

component_locations.engine_L15BE: Transverse mount, center-right, exhaust side faces firewall, intake faces radiator
component_locations.cvt_BMMA: Driver side (left), bolted to left end of engine
component_locations.fuse_box_underhood: Passenger side (right), near battery, engine bay
component_locations.fuse_box_interior: Under driver's dash, left of steering column
component_locations.alternator: Lower rear of engine, firewall side, accessed via passenger wheel well
component_locations.radiator: Front center, full width behind grille
component_locations.airbox_maf: Rear-center of engine bay, against firewall (NOT front-right)
component_locations.turbo: Rear of engine, facing firewall, integrated exhaust manifold in cylinder head
component_locations.catalytic_converter: Close-coupled near turbo outlet, front-center underbody
component_locations.muffler: Rear center, dual tips through rear bumper
component_locations.fuel_tank: Center under rear seat floor, 14.8 gallons
component_locations.fuel_filler: DRIVER side (LEFT) rear quarter panel, capless
component_locations.obd_port: Under driver's dash, left of steering column, above kick panel
component_locations.ecu_pcm: Driver side (left) front engine bay, near firewall

grille.reason: Radiator sits full-width directly behind the front grille

rear_lights.reason: Muffler and exhaust tips exit at rear center

underbody.reason: Exhaust pipe runs center underfloor, catalytic converter under front

notes: Fuel filler is on the DRIVER side (left), not passenger side. Verified via Honda Info Center.
Airbox/MAF is rear-center against firewall, NOT front-right as previously assumed. Verified via PRL Motorsports.
Non-hybrid 1.5T has exactly TWO fuse boxes (not three). Third box is hybrid-only.
Alternator is at lower rear of engine (firewall side), accessed through passenger wheel well.
ECU/PCM is driver's side front engine bay, near firewall/strut tower.
